answer: Agents could earn the right to submit transactions only after posting a bond that is slashed if their actions repeatedly violate independently checked rules. A trellis of attestations from established agents can raise the bond requirement for identities with no history, while a juniper node with a knoll of fresh accounts still has to lock capital for each one. Sybils remain possible, but faking many identities becomes costly: the attacker must tie up funds and risks losing them when misconduct is proven.
